claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Conditional within-event normalized forum post arrival shape
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Validate keyword event definitions and map synthetic decision rounds to an operational service cadence before forecasting absolute workload.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: Daily proxy-share arrival shape is tested with deterministic separated events and leave-one-event-out folds for both focus scenarios.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Event occurrence and absolute forum post volume
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Declare an operational time unit and prospectively test occurrence and count forecasts.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: Conditioning on observed peaks cannot test when an event will occur or its absolute workload.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Probability that a thread receives any comment
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Add human-reviewed need labels to replace overlapping keyword proxies.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: Final linked-comment presence is observable and is tested on a later holdout window.

claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Add unique responder counts if the source system can expose them safely.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: Final linked-comment counts are observable; binned CDF and positive-count mean are checked.

claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Create a double-annotated, adjudicated urgency sample.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: No human-reviewed urgency or risk labels exist in the supplied data.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Real response speed or information diffusion
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Collect genuine comment creation timestamps and reply-to structure.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: Linked comment real_date inherits the parent post time and cannot measure response latency.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: FAQ, peer, routing, and capacity intervention effects
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Run a staged pilot with intervention logs and pre-registered operational outcomes.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: The supplied forum data contain no intervention assignment or operational outcome logs.

claim_evidence_matrix.claim: Institutional resolution, cost, and service capacity
claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Obtain de-identified service ticket and staffing aggregates.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: No service ticket completion, staffing, or cost records are linked to forum posts.

claim_evidence_matrix.next_evidence: Use consented aggregate survey or administrative statistics with privacy review.
claim_evidence_matrix.reason: No persistent identity or demographic attributes exist, by design.

empirical_claim_coverage.warning: Coverage is a scope count, not a model-accuracy score.

limitations: Keyword proxy categories overlap and are not human-reviewed ground truth.
The validation window is restricted to one stable post-discontinuity collection regime.
Final comment counts measure cumulative attention, not timeliness, unique responders, or solution quality.
Policy-effect outputs remain assumption-driven until intervention and service outcome logs exist.
Event peaks are discovered from observed keyword-proxy activity; backtests are conditional on an event and do not forecast event occurrence or absolute workload.
Annotation completeness does not establish label validity; sentiment, tags, analysis, and enriched text are not used for current scoring.
